effect: The volcano and ocean produced a hydrothermal vent, completing the remaining goal and showing how vent chemistry can support life without sunlight.
reaction: The link between heated seawater, dissolved chemicals and life was a worthwhile surprise.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making the hydrothermal vent was most worthwhile: it connected volcanic heat and seawater to a possible energy source for life without sunlight.

leastWorthwhile.text: Forming the continent felt comparatively compressed: the result described crust gathering and reshaping, but the combination itself gave little sense of how that happens.

surprise.text: I was surprised that chemicals released at a hydrothermal vent can provide energy for organisms without sunlight.

arbitrary.text: Moving plates plus Earth producing a continent felt somewhat abstract, even though its purpose was clear from the goal.

continue.text: Yes. The concise geological explanations and the unexpected connection between vents and life make me curious to see what develops next.
